crossRefs.note: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.

crossRefs.note: won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.

crossRefs.note: Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.
For my eyes are on all their ways. They are not hidden from my face. Their iniquity isn’t concealed from my eyes.

translations.web: God, you know my foolishness. My sins aren’t hidden from you.
translations.bsb: You know my folly, O God, and my guilt is not hidden from You.
translations.kjv: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid
translations.asv: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; And my sins are not hid from thee.
